functions.name: encode_transport_frame
functions.comment: Confirmed in code: AA stuffing and additive checksum.

functions.name: decode_transport_byte
functions.comment: Confirmed in code: stateful AA-stuffed stream decoder.

functions.name: dispatch_local_uart_command
functions.comment: Handles companion-local identity, advertising and update commands.

functions.name: usb_tx_queue_service
functions.comment: Splits outgoing frames into chunks of at most 62 bytes.

functions.name: route_main_reply_to_gatt
functions.comment: Routes trailing 0x31 to AF01 with prefix 0x31; otherwise AF02. Saves host after successful bind reply notification.

functions.name: queue_gatt_to_main
functions.comment: Copies payload, appends 0x31 for route 0 or zero otherwise, creates type 6 internal frame.

functions.name: handle_af02_write
functions.comment: Handles 18 bind and 00 status locally, forwards other requests to main. Last request byte selects fast lookup.

functions.name: handle_af01_write
functions.comment: Handles C0/10 local settings; forwards other application commands.

functions.name: decode_main_uart_byte
functions.comment: AA-stuffed UART parser and checksum validation.

functions.name: route_main_uart_frame
functions.comment: Routes completed internal frames by destination type 6,1,5 or fallback.

functions.name: usb_receive_report
functions.comment: Reads length at HID byte 1 and feeds bytes starting at byte 2 into stream decoder.

functions.name: usb_send_report
functions.comment: Writes report ID 2 at byte 0, chunk length at byte 1, data at byte 2, sends 64 bytes.

functions.name: usb_interrupt_handler
functions.comment: USB endpoint events and descriptor/control transfers.

functions.name: notify_af02
functions.comment: Notification path using CCCD at 0x20003014 and AF02 handle at 0x20002c9a.

functions.name: notify_af01
functions.comment: Notification path using CCCD at 0x20003224 and AF01 handle at 0x20002c6a.

functions.name: initialize_ble_application
functions.comment: Registers BLE task, services, advertising and scan response data.

functions.name: load_saved_host_ids
functions.comment: Reads 80 bytes at nonvolatile offset 0x6f00 and counts non-ff 16-byte slots.

functions.name: save_host_id
functions.comment: Appends a 16-byte ID, shifts when five slots are filled, erases and writes offset 0x6f00.

functions.name: find_saved_host_id
functions.comment: Compares 16 input bytes with stored host IDs. Uses SDK tmos_memcmp boolean semantics.
